Subject: Afterparty leads flow and demo ops

Hey team,

Quick debrief from Saturday’s ‘Afterparty’ session — we captured ~420 registrants and ~128 live attendees. I ran a quick signal pass and attached a prioritized attendee CSV (columns: name, company, email, intent_score, role, notes). High-level ask: we need SDR triage + demo slots scheduled this week for the top tier.

Priority buckets (from scoring & interactions):
- Tier A (22 people): attended live, asked product questions, intent_score >= 85 — target 24–48h outreach, offer 30m technical demo or 45m evaluation session.
- Tier B (56 people): engaged but no specific demo ask, intent_score 60–84 — nurture + 15m discovery call, aim within 72h.
- Tier C (rest): content nurture and on-demand replay (no immediate SDR claim unless requested).

Operational asks:
1) Tessa — can you claim Tier A and confirm who owns which account by EOD? Please block demo windows in the shared demo calendar (link in Drive) and tag recordings.
2) Ben — please prepare the short deck (attached) stripped to a 12‑minute demo + 3 talking points about integration/ops. Send me the slide with your proposed cadence.
3) Lauren — can you spin up the replay landing page and make sure the tracking UTM is set so we can join to HubSpot contact records?

Notes on messaging: keep the opening touch light and executive-friendly for Tier A (1–2 lines referencing their question), include a calendar pick link with 3 options (morning/afternoon/late-afternoon PT). For Tier B, use the 15m discovery template and include the on-demand clip bundle.

Attachments: 20280603-attendee_list_afterparty.csv, redwood-afterparty-deck.pdf (slide deck for SDRs).

I’ll loop in Samantha from Novalyte once we have time slots — they were very warm.

Thanks,
Marcus
